Projects

Selected work in people science, organizational analytics, research design, and R-based data workflows.

Survey experiments · Workplace solidarity · Mediation

Linked Fate at Work

Examining how White women, Black women, and Latina women perceive shared workplace outcomes, what explains those perceptions, and how they shape reactions to gender-equality initiatives.

DEI commitments · Organizational credibility · Public context

When DEI Commitments Change

A multi-study case study on how people evaluate symbolic versus substantive DEI action, organizational backtracking, and credibility when companies revise public commitments.

Climate dialogue · Belief change · Behavioral intention

When Dialogue Does Not Persuade Symmetrically

Analyzing an online climate-conversation experiment to understand how exposure to opposing views shaped belief change and behavioral intentions differently for believers and skeptics.

ESM · Longitudinal data · Methods toolbox

Mapping Daily Mind Wandering with Experience Sampling

A small-pilot methods demonstration showing how daily survey data can be cleaned, visualized, and modeled to separate within-person dynamics from between-person differences.
